displayName: OCI-AI-SAF-002: AI — Safety — Self-Harm Content Facilitation
description:
Detects LLM responses that may facilitate or encourage self-harm behavior

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_saf_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%safety%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%self%') AND "value" > 0
